invitation.title: Would you like to launch the interactive tutorial?
invitation.description: Learn how to guide the game with a quick tour. You can start it now or find it later in the sidebar.
invitation.sidebarAvailable: The interactive tutorial is always available from the game sidebar.

welcome.title: You hold the answer. It's up to them to find it!
welcome.description: Welcome to the role of Game Master. You know the question and its answer, the players don't. Read the card aloud, listen to their guesses, answer their questions and guide them step by step towards the solution. Your role is not to trick them, but to lead a good investigation.

framework.title: Set the scene for the investigation
framework.description: Before asking the question, announce the theme, category and difficulty to the players. This information gives them an initial framework to think and steer their guesses. The difficulty simply indicates how hard the answer may be to deduce: it changes neither the rules nor the score.

question.title: Launch the investigation
question.description: Read the question aloud, then let the players lead the investigation. They can ask as many questions as they like to narrow down the possibilities. Answer only with Yes, No, or by choosing between two options. A wrong lead is not a failure: each answer lets players rule out possibilities and get closer to the solution.

clues.title: Your tools to guide them
clues.description: Context and Trivia are your toolbox for running the investigation. Use them to better understand the answer, settle a lead, or answer a more specific question. If the players get stuck, you can also use them to give a hint without directly revealing the solution. Keep the most revealing information for the right moment.

answer.title: It's up to you to validate the answer
answer.description: The Answer is your reference: keep it secret until the players think they have found it. They don't need to repeat the exact words on the card: if their suggestion matches the concept you're looking for, it's a win! As the Game Master, you decide when the investigation is solved.

sources.title: Reveal the story behind the answer
sources.description: Once the solution is found, reveal the answer and tell the story behind the question. Context and Trivia let you enrich this moment and share the most surprising details. Sources are there to dig deeper into the subject, check a fact, or answer the questions that come after the reveal.

continue.title: Ready for the next investigation?
continue.description: Investigation over? Move on to the Next question to continue the game. You can also hand the Game Master role to another player: everyone can then take a turn at presenting riddles. And if you want to revisit the previous card, use Previous when it's available.

sidebar.title: Everything is within reach
sidebar.description: The sidebar lets you find the game's settings and options, as well as the full Rules and this tutorial. No need to remember everything now: you can come back here whenever you like.
